# cozystack_package (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack Package by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_package" "bucket" {
  name = "cozystack.bucket-application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name.

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version.
- `components` (String) Per-component overrides as JSON.
- `id` (String) Object name.
- `ignore_dependencies` (List of String) Skipped dependencies.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).
- `variant` (String) Variant in use.
